rows.text: Independent review approved 1f2c385 after exact reproduction: the held startup response detached the focused editor; after removing the duplicate render, the same input retains its element, focus and typed value. The reviewer requested and approved a first-render guard for overlapping refreshes.

All nine focused browser cases pass, including unchanged background-Save and nested-layout assertions and the unchanged channel-navigation test after its prior worker crash. A fresh complete checkpoint is running on the committed source; full acceptance remains open.
